Title: Karan and the Family

Cast

1. Karan - 32 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Anjali - 29 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
3. Sunita - 62 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
4. Ajay - 38 years, general
Look: armour, a sword at the waist, thick moustache

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
4. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Karan stands in the court. Sunita and Ajay stand near him.]

Karan: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan sits down on the throne.]

Karan: "Mother, listen!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Anjali stands in the courtyard. Ajay stands near her.]

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Anjali washes clothes in a bucket.]

Anjali: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 3: The bathroom - Day

[Karan stands in the bathroom. Anjali stands near him.]

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[Karan shaves in front of the mirror.]

Karan: "I knew it!"

Scene 4: The forest - Day

[Karan stands in the forest. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Karan goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Karan (softly): "Okay, Mother."

[Karan rides an elephant through the forest.]

Karan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
